title: Spliced Choir Drift
description: An interleaved vocal-grain cloud cut from a single pitched dirt sample: striated slices scatter across the stereo field on a perlin drift while the grain count, formant vowel, and bit-crush degradation creep in over a 24-cycle pass. The tail is delay-only echo smear, no reverb.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  s("east*2")
    .striate("<6 8 12 8 16 8 12 6>/2")
    .speed(perlin.slow(13).range(0.85, 1.18))
    .pan(perlin.slow(7).range(0.08, 0.92))
    .vowel("<a e i o u e a o>/2")
    .bpf(saw.slow(23).range(420, 3200))
    .resonance(rand.slow(11).range(4, 13))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 1 4 1 2 8>/2")
    .crush(sine.slow(29).range(16, 6))
    .squiz(perlin.slow(17).range(0, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-1))
    .gain(0.85)
    .delay("0.55:0.1875:0.74")
    .delaytime(perlin.slow(31).range(0.12, 0.26))
    .orbit(2)
)
